title: Fixed Inclined Rail Seat Bay
description: One newly authored complete fixed inclined-rail seat installation appearance. A single continuous eight-tread stair plinth carries four complete finite anchor brackets and two uninterrupted inclined round guide rails. Two genuinely bored inclined carriage collars surround the rails and join a compact fixed saddle housing. A horizontal padded seat, full padded back, two open armrests and a forward footplate remain level in this one mid-slope pose. Whole end plates and support stems belong to the assembly. No old wheelchair, wheeled ladder or vertical lift cabin meshes are imported; the inclined captive carrier and horizontally seated support route are newly built. Three opaque untextured PBR materials, metres, Z up, centred horizontal bounds and grounded stair sole. One complete static prop, zero scenes and no people. No actual travel, drive internals, braking, collision-free motion, seat swivel, user fit, accessibility, boarding, fall protection, load, installation or safety certification. Not construction or operating instructions.
